name: Problem Solving
description: Word problems, one step at a time

levels.name: P1 Story Sums
levels.description: Short stories about adding and taking away

questions.text: Mia has 9 stickers. She gets 6 more. How many stickers does she have now?
There are 17 birds on a tree. 8 fly away. How many are left?
Ben has 4 bags with 2 oranges in each bag. How many oranges?
A toy costs $8. Lily has $5. How much more does she need?
Tom is 7 years old. His sister is 3 years older. How old is his sister?
A baker made 145 buns in the morning and 128 in the afternoon. How many buns did he make?
5 children each have 6 marbles. How many marbles are there in all?
Sam had $50. He bought a book for $18 and a pen for $7. How much is left?
40 cupcakes are packed into boxes of 4. How many boxes are needed?
A jug holds 2 litres of water. Dad pours out 750 ml. How much is left?

levels.name: P3 Bar Models
levels.description: Draw a bar model to see the answer

questions.text: Ali has 3 times as many cards as Ben. Ben has 24 cards. How many cards do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Ben is 1 unit, Ali is 3 units: 4 units in all.

questions.text: A shop sold 1250 apples on Monday and 380 fewer on Tuesday. How many apples were sold on Tuesday?
8 pencils cost $6. How much do 4 pencils cost?
Mum cut a cake into 8 equal pieces. The family ate 5 pieces. What fraction is left?
A school bus leaves at 7.20 a.m. and arrives 45 minutes later. When does it arrive?

levels.name: P4 Word Problems
levels.description: Fractions, decimals and area in stories

questions.text: Jane spent 2/5 of her $30 on a book. How much did the book cost?
A garden is 12 m long and 9 m wide. What is its area?
3 bottles hold 1.5 litres each. How much do they hold altogether?
Raju is 1.42 m tall. His brother is 0.18 m shorter. How tall is his brother?
Tickets cost $9 each. A class paid $315 for tickets. How many tickets did they buy?

levels.name: P5 Word Problems
levels.description: Ratio, percentage and volume in stories

questions.text: Ann and Bala share $84 in the ratio 3 : 4. How much does Bala get?
A tank 50 cm by 30 cm by 20 cm is filled with water. How many litres is that? (1 litre = 1000 cm³)
40% of the 250 pupils walk to school. How many pupils walk?
A rope 7 1/2 m long is cut into 3 equal pieces. How long is each piece?
Mrs Tan bought 6 kg of rice at $2.35 per kg. How much did she pay?
A train travels at 80 km/h for 2 1/2 hours. How far does it travel?
The average mass of 5 boys is 42 kg. One boy of 50 kg leaves. What is the new average?
questions.hint: Total 210 kg, minus 50 kg, shared by 4.

questions.text: John had some money. He spent 1/3 of it, then 1/4 of the rest, and had $30 left. How much did he have at first?
questions.hint: After spending 1/3, 2/3 is left; 3/4 of that is half of the money.

questions.text: A semicircle has a diameter of 14 cm. Taking π = 22/7, what is its area?
The price of a bag went up from $50 to $60. What is the percentage increase?
